title: Fold and Draw · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Fold and Draw · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Fold a sheet in half and open it to show the crease. The lead draws a simple shape on one side and copies its mirror image on the other. The group agrees the two shapes approximately mirror across the crease. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Fold and Draw, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees the two shapes approximately mirror across the crease.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees the two shapes approximately mirror across the crease.
